app.name: VoiceToClipboard
topbar.retranscribe.empty: Nothing to re-transcribe yet — record first
mic.title: Click to record · Click again to submit · Drag to move · Ctrl+Alt+V
settings.title: Settings
lang.label: UI Language
lang.note: Interface language and speech hint. Applies instantly, offline.
hotkey.label: Global Recording Hotkey
hotkey.note: Click input or Change Key, then press key combination.
hotkey.listeningNote: Press the key combination now. ESC cancels.
hotkey.invalid: That key can't be used as a hotkey on this layout. Try another.
finishSound.note: A soft two-tone chime plays when the transcript is copied. Turn off for silent operation.
engine.label: STT Engine
models.label: Offline Local Models
models.note: Every model auto-detects the language — no language setting, ever. {reco} = best match for your PC's RAM {ram}.
models.cachePath: Model cache location is shown after startup.
eco.label: Power-Saving Mode
eco.note: On (default): loads the model only while transcribing, then frees the RAM. Off: keeps the model always loaded for the lowest latency.
gemini.cooldownNote: Gemini rate limit active — retry in about {s}s.
gemini.cooldownState: {keys} key(s) and {models} model(s) are cooling down — next retry in about {s}s.
gemini.note: One key only. If GEMINI_API_KEY is set in Windows it takes priority and this field is hidden.
autostop.label: Auto-Stop on Silence
autostop.calibrate.feedback: Auto-calibration measures your background noise for a few seconds and sets the threshold so silence never triggers a stop.
autostop.calibrate.quiet: Calibrated: background noise ~{mid} (very quiet room) → threshold {newThresh}. Speak normally — if stops cut you off, raise it a bit.
autostop.calibrate.loud: Calibrated: background noise ~{mid} (loud room!) → threshold {newThresh}. You may want to move closer to the mic or reduce the noise.
autostop.calibrate.dontTalk: Don't talk — just let the background noise play for {s} seconds.
spacepaste.label: Enable Space-to-Paste (bubble after transcribing)
output.label: Output mode
output.method.label: Injection method
output.autotypeNote: Types the transcript into the active window. Preserves clipboard. If an app blocks it, switch to 'Paste' method.
settingsWindow.title: VoiceToClipboard Settings
bubble.title: ✓ Transcribed
toast.title: ✓ Transcribed
toast.body: Click to paste into the previous window
model.tiny-multilingual.name: Moonshine v2 Base · Ultra-Fast (INT8)
model.tiny-multilingual.desc: Useful Sensors Moonshine v2 Base INT8. Lightweight, ~5× faster time-to-first-token, auto English, Spanish, Chinese dictation with instant low-RAM wake.
model.mini-multilingual.name: FastConformer Transducer · 10 languages
model.mini-multilingual.desc: Mini NVIDIA NeMo FastConformer Transducer. Auto English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian, Croatian, Belgian — the best light multilingual pick.
model.zh-en-light.name: SenseVoice · Chinese + English (Light)
model.zh-en-light.desc: Alibaba SenseVoice int8 — mainly Chinese, plus English, Cantonese, Japanese, Korean. Automatic language detection, ~400 MB RAM.
model.omni-multilingual.name: Whisper Small INT8 · Global Multilingual
model.omni-multilingual.desc: OpenAI Whisper Small INT8. High accuracy across 99+ languages including English, Spanish, Chinese. The universal default pick.
model.big-multilingual.name: Whisper Turbo INT8 · Max Precision
model.big-multilingual.desc: Maximum-precision OpenAI Whisper Turbo INT8. SOTA accuracy for English, Spanish, Chinese, and 99+ languages with distilled 4-layer decoder.
model.zh-en-big.name: FireRedASR2 CTC · Chinese + English (Big)
model.zh-en-big.desc: ByteDance FireRedASR2 int8 — mainly Chinese, plus English. The highest-precision Chinese model here, ~1 GB RAM.
model.extracting: Extracting & verifying… (may take a minute or two)
models.qualityNote: RAM is used only while transcribing when Power-Saving Mode is on — bigger models = higher accuracy.

appearance.widgetStyleTooltip: Recolor the widget and this window.

recordings.label: Voice Recordings
recordings.note: All voice messages are automatically saved as audio files on your PC and kept forever.
recordings.toggleLabel: Save Audio Recordings Locally (Disabled by default)
recordings.toggleNote: Disabled by default. When enabled, recorded voice audio files are saved locally on your PC.
mic.label: Microphone
mic.note: Select input device for voice capture.
history.toggleNote: Save transcriptions locally for search and quick reuse.
history.confirmClear: Are you sure you want to clear all transcription history?
history.emptyHint: Record something and it will appear here.
welcome.title: Welcome to VoiceToClipboard
welcome.body: Tap the mic to record — tap again to transcribe. Or use your global hotkey anywhere.
welcome.step1: Click the mic button to start and stop recording
welcome.step2: Use the gear button (top right) to open Settings
welcome.step3: Press Ctrl+Alt+V anywhere to record hands-free
welcome.modelHint: Choose a local model in Settings, then download it before your first offline transcription.
